subject: delta(client): WF say which protocol checks still read the host stop when verifyDeal runs under it
note: The README said verifyDeal reads the host stop only to decide whether to continue. For a native-payment purchase in payment_handoff whose buyer nonce has moved, verifyDeal asks the protocol's nativePaymentRefused, which the stop refuses, so verifyDeal rejects writes_stopped; and a stopped release of native source intents at a settled nonce is recorded as pending. The README now says so. No code changes.
